name: pczone
description: PCZone – Đồ án chuyên ngành. Monorepo: web (Next.js) + api (Express) + crawler + db (Prisma).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:build
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:data && npm run seed-images && npm run demo-data
scripts.dev:api: npm run db:build && npm run dev -w @pczone/api
scripts.build: npm run db:build && npm run build -w @pczone/api && npm run build -w @pczone/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:build && npm run typecheck -w @pczone/api
